chapter.title: Energy in Our Community
chapter.p: Energy makes change possible. A moving bicycle has kinetic energy. A book resting on a high shelf has gravitational potential energy because of its position.

section.title: Where does electricity come from?
section.p: Electricity can be generated in several ways. Solar panels convert light into electrical energy. Wind turbines transfer energy from moving air to a generator. Hydroelectric stations use moving water. Each method has benefits and limits.

section.title: Investigate a school building
section.p: Choose three devices in a classroom. Record the device, its power rating in watts, and the estimated hours of use each day.

section.title: Compare the data
section.p: Calculate the daily energy estimate for each device. Explain why the highest-power device does not always use the most energy.
